It offers digital transformation services, including data analytics, connected products, intelligent automation, cloud, transformation, and blockchain services; and enterprise technologies and services in the areas of Oracle and JD Edwards, SAP, Infor, Microsoft, customer relationship management, manufacturing execution systems, product lifecycle management, supply chain…

CERA.NS.d: Cera Sanitaryware Limited manufactures, sells, trades in, and outsources sanitary ware and faucet ware products in India. It offers sanitary ware products, including EWC's, wash basins, cisterns, seat covers, urinals, electronic flushing systems, water saving products, bath accessories, and kids range products, as well as special needs products.

DCMSIL.NS.d: DCM Shriram International Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker DCMSIL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

DREAMFOLKS.NS.d: Dreamfolks Services Limited supplies airport services in India, including lounge entry, meet and assist, transfers to and from airports, dining, doorstep baggage handling, and spa and wellness. Incorporated in 2008, it is based in Gurugram.

EFORCE.NS.d: Electro Force (India) Ltd. designs and manufactures precision sheet metal components, plastic injection moldings, and related assemblies. The company specializes in providing advanced manufacturing solutions for complex precision components for various industries, primarily in India.

ELGIEQUIP.NS.d: ELGI Equipments Limited manufactures and sells air compressors and related parts in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Air Compressors and Automotive Equipments. The company offers oil lubricated screw compressors, oil free piston air compressors, oil free screw compressors, oil lubricated piston compressors, diesel portable air compressors, electric portable compressors, railway air compressors, heat recovery systems, and medical air compressors and vacuum pumps, as well as accessories.

GRINDWELL.NS.d: Grindwell Norton Limited manufactures and sells abrasives, ceramics, and plastic products in India. The company offers bonded abrasives in the form of wheels and other shapes, such as segments, sticks, etc. for various applications, including lapping, honing, super-finishing, race grinding, thread grinding, fluting, OD grinding, ID grinding, surface grinding, etc., as well as for rough applications comprising snagging, cutting-off, burr removal, weld preparation, etc.

ICICIGI.NS.d: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited provides various general insurance products and services in India. The company offers motor, car, two wheeler, health, health booster, personal accident, international travel, home, marine, workmen compensation, NRI, business, third party, crop, rural, and cyber insurance products; and provides reinsurance services. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India. ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited is a subsidiary of ICICI Bank Limited.

IEML.NS.d: Indian Emulsifiers Ltd. operates as a manufacturer and supplier of specialty chemicals, serving a broad range of industries. The company's product portfolio includes esters, esterquats, polyamides, polymerized surfactants, sulphates, amphoterics, phosphate esters, imidazolines, wax emulsions, and other formulated specialty products, with a diverse offering of over 125 products.

INDIFRA.NS.d: Indifra Ltd. is an Indian infrastructure and management services provider that primarily operates within the City Gas Distribution (CGD) and electrical contracting sectors. The company functions as a service partner to various gas distribution entities, offering end-to-end management solutions and infrastructure development, including laying pipelines and providing maintenance for gas distribution networks. Additionally, Indifra Ltd. engages in electrical contracting services for industrial and commercial clients.

JNKINDIA.NS.d: JNK India Limited, a heating equipment specialist based in Thane, began in 2010 as JNK India Private Limited. It provides complete solutions for process-fired heaters, reformers and cracking furnaces, from design and engineering through manufacturing, installation and commissioning. It also supplies flare systems and incinerators for waste gas management and takes on renewable energy projects.

JUSTDIAL.NS.d: Just Dial Limited engages in the search engine business under the Justdial brand name in India and internationally. The company offers local search, search related, and software services through various platforms, including internet, mobile internet, over the telephone, and text. It also provides review and rating certification services under the JD Ratings name; and online payment services under the JD Pay name.

KPEL.NS.d: K.P. Energy Ltd. supplies complete balance-of-plant solutions to India's wind energy industry, for wind and hybrid wind-solar projects. Its services cover operations and maintenance, grid integration, infrastructure erection, logistics, ground preparation, and finding and acquiring sites.

MOTHERSUMI.NS.d: Motherson Sumi Systems Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of components to automotive original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally. It operates in MSSL Standalone, SMR, SMP, PKC, and Others segments.

NINSYS.NS.d: NINtec Systems Ltd is an Ahmedabad-based Indian company founded in 2015 that provides software development services and technology solutions. Its offerings include business analytics, cloud services spanning advisory, infrastructure, integration, management and security, application engineering, a range of testing services, and AI and machine learning solutions.

ORKLAINDIA.NS.d: Orkla India Ltd. is a food company that produces and sells spices and convenience foods worldwide. Its range includes blended masalas for dishes such as sambar, rasam and puliogare, and pure spices including chilli, turmeric, coriander and cumin.

PAGEIND.NS.d: Page Industries Limited manufactures, markets, and distributes textile garments and clothing accessories for men, women, and junior girls and boys. It offers vests, briefs, boxer briefs, trunks, boxer shorts, inner tees, midways, brassiers, sports bra, panties, camisole, crop top, tank tops, shapewear, shorties, bloomers, t-shirts, shorts, capris, track pants, pyjamas, sweat shirts, jackets, polo t-shirts, and sweat shirts, bermudas, lounge pants, sports shorts, gym vests, yoga pants, sleepwear, muscle vest, and…

PAYTM.NS.d: One97 Communications Limited is a digital platform based in Noida and founded in 2000, offering payment, financial, and commerce and cloud services to consumers and businesses in India. Through the Paytm app, users can make mobile recharges, bill payments, rent and education fee payments, wallet top-ups and money transfers, using cards, net banking or Paytm's own instruments.

POLICYBZR.NS.d: PB Fintech Limited is an Indian company operating a digital platform for access to insurance and credit products. Its segments are Insurance Web Aggregator Services and Other Services. Its online portal, Policybazaar, is a marketplace where consumers and insurance partners buy and sell insurance products.

PRITIKAUTO.NS.d: Pritika Auto Industries Limited, established in 1980 and headquartered in Mohali, makes and distributes tractor and automotive components, including axle, wheel, hydraulic lift and brake housings, end covers, differential carriers, cylinder blocks, crankcases and motor vehicle accessories. It also trades industrial equipment and tools, provides iron casting and offers engineering solutions, mostly in India.

RAMCOSYS.NS.d: Ramco Systems Limited operates as an enterprise software company in India, the Americas, Europe, APAC, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers Ramco AviationSoftware, an enterprise-wide M&E/MRO software to address the needs of airlines, heli operators, MROs, and business aviation segments; Ramco VirtualWorks, a software meta model that captures data required to generate and deliver solutions in various technology platforms; and Ramco DecisionWorks for analytics/reporting.

SABAR.NS.d: Sabar Flex India Ltd. manufactures and supplies a diverse range of flexible packaging materials derived from plastics. Its product portfolio includes flexible packaging, stretch wrap and silage stretch films, low-density polyethylene shrink wrap films, multilayer coextruded polyethylene and co-polymer films, mulch and color plastic film, liner bags, and printing inks.

SEIL.NS.d: Shanti Educational Initiatives Limited focuses on providing educational services and establishing educational institutions in India, offering a range of academic programs. The company aims to deliver quality education and promote holistic development. The company is based in India.

SERVOTECH-SM.NS.d: SERVOTECH POWER SY manufactures and supplies power conditioning and energy-efficient solutions. It provides products such as solar power systems, LED lighting, and power backup solutions. The company is based in India.

SHRIRAMPPS.NS.d: Shriram Properties Limited, established in 1995 and based in Bengaluru, is an India-based real estate developer. It builds residential projects across affordable, mid-market, premium and luxury segments, as well as commercial and office premises and plotted land, mainly in major cities such as Bengaluru and Chennai.

TREJHARA.NS.d: Trejhara Solutions Limited provides technology products and solutions in the Asia Pacific and internationally. The company offers Interact DX, a communication management product suite in the digitization domain, which provides interactive personalized communication including audio video technology, bills, statements, targeted advertisements, policy kits, welcome kits, receipts, loyalty/rewards, KYC forms, advisory, and notifications across multiple channels, such as email, web, mobile, print, and kiosk.

UMAEXPORTS.NS.d: Uma Exports Limited trades and distributes agricultural commodities internationally. Its products include sugar, spices such as cumin seeds, coriander, turmeric and dry red chilies, grains such as maize, wheat and rice, and also sorghum, tea and pulses.

VENUSPIPES.NS.d: Venus Pipes and Tubes Limited was established in 2015 and is headquartered in Dhaneti, India. It manufactures and distributes stainless steel pipes and tubes under the Venus brand, including precision, heat exchanger, hydraulic, instrumentation, seamless, welded and box products. Sales are mainly in India, with notable exports.

VISAKAIND.NS.d: Visaka Industries Limited manufactures and sells corrugated cement fiber sheets in India. The company operates in two segments, Building Products and Synthetic Yarn. It offers cement asbestos, such as close fitting adjustable ridges, apron pieces, cladding/walling, north light ridges, barge boards, north light curves, serrated adjustable ridges, roof lights, and ridge finials.
